additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE concerns only the exact typed trigger question; it neither rejects the source duty or permission nor authorizes pruning it from a broader compliance model.

Footnote 3 is supplied in u30 and referenced by both XML in u4 and PDF in u5. The extraction's missing-footnote and unresolved-format-antecedent statements are stale. The web-form method in u6 has no such marker. Extending this certificate requirement to every STREAMS 2 method would add an unsupported restriction.

SUPPORTED for the PDF claim means that PDF upload is an authorized method subject to its qualifications. If the extraction's condition list is treated as an exhaustive statement of sufficient permission, omission of e-Cert is unsupported. This extraction concern does not establish a defect in a formula answering only the resubmission-trigger question.

The XML passage separately requires liaison with JFIU as soon as possible to arrange a technical test. Treating the atomic schema claim as the complete set of XML transition duties would omit that obligation; its absence from the history-trigger predicate is not itself a defect.

The date-only candidate node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes actual other-channel filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. Unit u3 states a calendar-date effective date, while u11 and u13 identify 9:00am as resumption and launch. Preserve the date-effective and operational-launch interpretations of 'following its implementation'; the candidate predicates are not equivalent at that boundary.

The source does not explicitly state a timezone or precisely resolve whether 'following its implementation' includes the launch instant. Authoritative clarification of the governing timezone and temporal boundary is missing, with no identifiable supplied dependency mapping. Those unresolved matters concern temporal classification and must not be forced into a failing certificate or format assessment.

The blackout provision permits direct urgent contact; it does not establish that every email, call or fax constitutes an STR submission. Conversely, an actual submission established through such contact should not be excluded merely because contact was involved. Preserve the distinction between contact alone and an actual submission.

node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb places actual submission in its result rather than scope. For a licensed firm with a known non-submission and no conflicts, it returns FALSE, while the other event candidates place actual filing in scope and return OUT_OF_SCOPE. This is an observable typed-outcome difference requiring a domain decision if non-submission inputs are admitted.

The trigger formulas do not determine whether a STREAMS 2 filing satisfies prescribed format, schema or certificate requirements. FALSE must not be interpreted as filing compliance or permission to use another channel. Adding those compliance predicates as trigger conditions would require separate source support.

The history candidate delegates event quantification and the evidence needed for a negative finding to an externally supplied Boolean. Its executable expression does not verify that the same report is tracked, that qualifying events are captured, or that history is sufficient to support FALSE. Missing history must not silently become a negative aggregate.

A later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase an earlier triggering event. These questions concern historical trigger existence, not whether a duty remains outstanding. Automatic migration described in u13 is also distinct from a new submission by a firm.

The history candidate classifies the entity responsible for the assessed report, whereas the explicit original-event candidate classifies the original submitter. Their equivalence is not established for histories involving different entities. The supplied source does not resolve responsibility transfers.

The JFIU resubmission guidance promised in u28 is not supplied. It is not needed to establish the express trigger, but it may be needed to resolve resubmission procedures or disputed boundary cases. No supplied dependency ID can be identified as that guidance.

All four supplied external dependency entries have null source_hash values and no descriptions identifying their authorities. None supports AVAILABLE, and their identifiers cannot be assigned to the PDF specification, XML schema, temporal clarification or resubmission guidance by guesswork.
